description: Gabarit limite des obstacles hauts Fret is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Gabarit limite des obstacles hauts pour le Fret sur les lignes du Réseau Ferré National. Le gabarit indique la classification de la voie à la fois pour le gabarit de chargement (c’est-à-dire la limite d’encombrement que doit respecter le couple wagon-chargement circulant sur la portion de voie décrite) et pour le gabarit cinématique (c’est-à-dire le ... Coverage: France. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Description du réseau. Its keywords are SNCF RESEAU, Lignes, Infrastructure, Gabarit, Fret, Géolocalisation. The portal shows 2020-05-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
